output:
PASS: missing-year plot gaps, exact source precision, keyboard point inspection (component only)
PASS: hourly axes, exact IST interval labels and evidence inspection (component only)

PASS: answer-first headline carries the exact retrieved value, unit and place (component only)
PASS: the validity ruler draws covered spans from the retrieved window with a text description
PASS: no window is drawn where the evidence has no interval
PASS: the evidence receipt keeps entity, window, source, locator and retrieval time together
PASS: task accounting reports asked, answered and incomplete separately from one another
PASS: retrieved volume stays bounded and plotted values are not duplicated as cards
PASS: a between-source difference is reported as a difference, not as skill or confidence
PASS: place clarification offers every candidate and returns the chosen selection id
PASS: an unwritten requested language is disclosed instead of passing as a complete answer
PASS: an unverified warning state stays held and implies no value or receipt
PASS: an airport report shows its raw text, its kind, and does not imply a flight status
PASS: every displayed number comes from the returned packet, with no arithmetic applied
PASS: no renderer leaks a stylesheet class name into the visible text of an answer
PASS: a series answer leads with its computed value and never with one arbitrary member
PASS: an official warning day is presented as a named period with its colour, hazard and window
PASS: the raw-packet inspector shows the exact rendered packet in the drawer
PASS: the stage readout reports checkpoints and queue position, never a percentage
PASS: a whole-edition reading and a cross-edition difference are labelled, counted and never ranked
PASS: two products in one turn are compared in plain terms and never ranked
PASS: a plan question offers quick replies, and a saved plan card offers Change and Undo

PASS: passage uses its bound citation, page locator, literal source text and HTTPS-only link (component only)
PASS: a non-HTTPS source URL is never offered as a link
PASS: immutable stored PDF page is preferred to a changing publisher URL
PASS: parent context is labelled separately from crop evidence and current alerts
PASS: saved PDF has a same-origin download fallback
PASS: the saved PDF opens in place from this origin only, on request

PASS: an empty question is refused in the page without a request (component only)
PASS: a question sends only accepted keys and retires the opening card
PASS: a follow-up keeps the conversation id and never sends the rejected legacy key
PASS: choosing an offered place sends that selection id back to the engine
PASS: a full queue is reported as a bounded queue
PASS: an expired token and an unavailable store produce different, accurate states
PASS: stopping a turn requests cancellation and reports the server response
PASS: collecting fresh evidence posts the resolved point and reports claims honestly
PASS: a new conversation clears the thread and identifier without sending a question
PASS: the ledger lists and searches the stored conversations
PASS: a stored conversation is deleted through the local route only
PASS: the field builder writes the editable question box and never submits on its own
PASS: the resolved collection point comes from the packet, or is reported absent

PASS: every surface has a renderer, including the map (component only)
PASS: the overview surface paints the national tally and keeps its caveats
PASS: the warnings surface writes an alert brief that names its sources and its limits
PASS: the observations surface lists stations, freshness and unstated units
PASS: the forecast surface renders a series chart
PASS: the climate surface renders the published record
PASS: the aviation surface shows the raw report and its limit
PASS: the marine surface names the answering cell or its limit
PASS: the settings surface lists capabilities, sources and their terms
PASS: the advisories surface offers the district directory
PASS: the changes surface reports vintage variance and its skill limit
PASS: the map draws one path per district, flags placeholder geometry and never colours an unmapped district green
PASS: the districts behave as one tab stop with arrow keys, Home and End, and Enter opens the district
PASS: the watch panel lists saved plans and their notifications, and checks plans on request
PASS: the watch panel reads the local inbox and checks watches only on request
PASS: appearance cycles system, day and night and records the choice
PASS: the rail readout shows collection health rows
PASS: the command palette lists surfaces, places and recents and runs the chosen item
PASS: every surface request carries the workspace token

PASS: the language selector offers measured write languages and tracks measured speech
PASS: a transcript is shown, labelled with recognition-only confidence, and confirmable
PASS: speech is refused, not guessed, where the project has not measured it
PASS: the briefcase keeps, reopens, exports and deletes composed briefs, reads the briefing series it holds, and discloses the reading position rather than treating it as evidence

PASS: published hazards, missing dates, expired days and explicit quiet remain distinct
PASS: network-shaped observations keep station identity, freshness, zero and unknown units
PASS: a late response from an earlier drawer cannot overwrite a new task
PASS: a timed-out source read explains that server work may continue
PASS: one source failure leaves the other sections and searchable tools usable
PASS: guided task snapshots the selected place and prepares a reviewable question
